cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Hand me the drawer key before I sign the club accounts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. My signature covers the receipts too. Let me check how it adds up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If you find a mistake, my name goes on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put mine beside yours. Give me the key and we'll correct it together before either name goes outside this room.
